cards.text: Israel's been camped in the Wilderness of Sinai, with God's cloud resting over the tabernacle. The rule is simple: when the cloud stays, they stay, and when it lifts, they move (Numbers 9:17-22). Then, on the twentieth day of the second month of the second year, the cloud lifts.

cards.question: The cloud lifts, and Israel sets out from the Wilderness of Sinai, traveling from place to place. Where does the cloud finally settle?

cards.text: This is the very first time the whole nation sets out like this. I can't carry three trays across my bakery without one hitting the floor, and these folks are moving a whole NATION.

cards.question: Israel sets out from Sinai this first time because the tribe leaders decided it was time to go.

cards.text: Then they march out in order, camp by camp, each under its own standard: Judah first, then Reuben, then Ephraim, and Dan last as the rear guard for everybody. The Gershonites and Merarites carry the tabernacle after Judah, and the Kohathites carry the holy objects after Reuben, with the tabernacle to be set up before they arrive.
Then Moses, Israel's leader, turns to Hobab, the son of Moses' father-in-law Reuel the Midianite. Israel is headed for the place the LORD said He would give them, and Moses wants Hobab to come along.

cards.question: Moses invites Hobab to come with Israel and says they'll treat him well. What reason does Moses give?

answers.text: The LORD has promised good things to Israel
The LORD has given Israel a strong army
The LORD has asked for Hobab by name

cards.question: Hobab gives Moses his answer. What does Hobab say he's going to do?

answers.text: Go back to his own land and people
Go on ahead to scout the way

cards.question: Moses doesn't give up on Hobab. What does Moses say Hobab knows that Israel needs?

answers.text: Where they should camp in the wilderness
How to speak with the kings nearby
Which roads the enemy armies travel

cards.text: Moses says, "Please do not leave us," and tells Hobab he can serve as their eyes. Friend, Moses just heard a no and came right back with a PLEASE.

cards.question: Moses makes Hobab a promise: if he comes, Israel will ___ with him whatever good things the LORD gives them.

cards.text: Then they set out from the mountain of the LORD on a three-day journey. And something goes out in front of them the whole way.

cards.question: For those three days out from the mountain of the LORD, what travels ahead of Israel?
The ark of the covenant goes ahead of Israel for three days to seek a ___ place for them.
As Israel sets out from the camp, the cloud of the LORD is over them by day.
Whenever the ark of the covenant sets out ahead of Israel, Moses calls out to the LORD. What does he ask?

answers.text: For the LORD to rise up and scatter His enemies
For the LORD to make the road ahead smooth
For the LORD to send water to the camp

cards.text: And whenever the ark comes to rest, Moses says, "Return, O LORD, to the countless thousands of Israel." EVERY time, friend, and I can't even remember to set my timer every time.
